data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native clean editorial photograph, Arm A text-free static-format test
Primary request: Create a tactile, calming desktop sand-garden editorial image in which the exact small Junwait blue smiling middle-finger statue from Image 1 sits serenely at the center. Pale raked sand, stones, and soft window light should look saveable and genuinely soothing first; the statue's peaceful smile and unmistakable finger-head create the rude second-look contradiction. It must never resemble an ad.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole and strict product-identity reference. Preserve one small roughly 4.7-inch-tall matte-blue synthetic-resin character: round seated blue body, short blue sleeves/arms, two tiny flesh-tone hands, two tiny flesh-tone bare feet, and one single tall flesh-tone raised middle finger emerging from the collar that is also the character's long smiling face and head, with narrow closed eyes, long nose ridge, and subtle smile. Do not split the finger/head into a separate hand. Do not add other fingers, arms, limbs, facial features, clothing, or accessories. Keep the visible front silhouette authoritative.
Scene/backdrop: a rectangular black-walnut desktop zen garden roughly 12 by 16 inches on a quiet dark wood writing desk, filled with fine warm ivory sand raked into clean concentric lines, three smooth charcoal river stones, one small bronze rake lying outside the tray, and soft linen curtains blurred behind. No bonsai, incense, people, symbols, words, labels, or religious objects.
Subject: the exact statue sits upright in the center-back of the shallow sand tray, only its tiny feet lightly touching the sand, not buried. Its complete front silhouette, blue body, tiny hands and feet, and single smiling flesh-tone finger-head remain inspectable and at believable four-to-five-inch scale. Concentric raked lines lead toward it without forming any letters or icons.
Style/medium: photorealistic contemporary interiors and desk-styling photography, tactile natural materials, subtle analog film grain, dry understated humor, not glossy campaign polish.
Composition/framing: strict vertical 2:3, slightly elevated three-quarter close view, full tray visible in the lower two-thirds, statue centered but not isolated as a product packshot, shallow depth of field with the product fully sharp. One immediately legible visual idea.
Lighting/mood: diffuse cool morning window light with one small warm reflection from the desk, peaceful and impeccably composed.
Color palette: ivory sand, black walnut, charcoal stone, soft linen, muted turquoise-blue body, and flesh-tone finger/head, hands, and feet.
Text: absolutely no added text, typography, captions, headlines, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, badges, prices, or CTA anywhere.
Constraints: one exact statue only; believable small scale; feet visible and lightly grounded; no package, border, collage, UI, product label, separate raised hand, extra finger, extra limb, human-scale statue, human, floating object, or templated campaign framing.
Avoid: religious symbolism, Japanese characters, giant garden, beach scene, cartoon, claymation, mascot redesign, commercial packshot, generic AI gloss, malformed face, extra fingers, duplicated product, buried feet, impossible shadows.
data.changesFromParent: A deliberately different tactile wellness/desk-styling execution rather than an office narrative or angle variant.
notes: Generated separately from the exact saved Amazon source image and inspected at full useful resolution.
Rejected because the centered sand-tray staging weakens the office-specific product-derived narrative and could accept many unrelated figurines.
